latest_release.name: v5.3.9
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed

### CSS

* Guard placeholder glow/wave animations behind prefers-reduced-motion by @julien-deramond in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42769
* Add `.modal-xxl` size to modals by @julien-deramond in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/43291
* Rename datetime edit minute pseudo-element by @kataokatsuki in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42935

### JavaScript

* fix(util): correct typo in isVisible comment (falsie → falsely) by @fauzan171 in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42478
* Fix carousel touch handling without Pointer Events by @Kevinjohn in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42714
* Improve JSDoc of `parseSelector`, `reflow` and `getNextActiveElement` in `js/src/util/index.js` by @fauzan171 in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42479
* Use `Element[]` for `getNextActiveElement`'s `list` param in JSDoc by @julien-deramond in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42978
* Carousel: don't throw when no indicator is active by @njarrar in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42974
* Fix ScrollSpy smooth scroll from nested link content by @ShiroKSH in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42673
* v5: Preserve literal tooltip and popover text from data attributes by @mdo in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/43319

### Docs

* #41690: [docs] Tables doc - Variants code examples miss table class by @stefan-korn in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/41691
* Update a link in introduction.mdx by @Shakil-Shahadat in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/41861
* Add incident response plan documentation by @mdo in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/41905
* Remove link to translation associated with supply chain attack by @bardiharborow in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/41973
* Add astro-broken-links-checker to detect and fix broken internal links by @julien-deramond in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42178
* Bump year to 2026 by @julien-deramond in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42208
* Fix link in CONTRIBUTING.md to GitHub blog by @coliff in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42207
* Use `.ncurc.json` instead of args in command line and enforce decisions in Dependabot by @julien-deramond in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42315
* Add cooldown configuration for Dependabot by @coliff in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42370
* docs(floating-labels): capitalize JavaScript by @stafferin in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42364
* Docs: enable `prettier-plugin-astro` plugin by @julien-deramond in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42390
* docs: Heroes example Replace unstyled checkbox with form-check by @coliff in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42406
* docs: Remove iOS Navbar Dropdowns section (no longer relevant) by @coliff in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42424
* docs: fix wording in toasts 'show' doc by @coliff in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42428
* v5: examples: Replace deprecated classes by @coliff in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42423
* Replace actions-cool/issues-helper by actions/stale by @julien-deramond in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42433
* Replace actions-cool/issues-helper by actions/github-script by @julien-deramond in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42435
* Use `node-version-file` in GitHub workflows by @Rishikesh183 in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42416
* docs: fix incident response security link by @ifer47 in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42468
* fix(util): correct typo in isVisible comment (falsie → falsely) by @fauzan171 in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42478
* Docs: add missing `role='button'` to `<a>` dropdowns by @julien-deramond in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42482
* Improve Security Policy score by @julien-deramond in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42481
* Examples: remove unused `.text-small` by @julien-deramond in https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/pull/42565

detail.readme:
Bootstrap

Sleek, intuitive, and powerful front-end framework for faster and easier web development.
Explore Bootstrap docs »

Report bug · Request feature · Blog

## Bootstrap 6 Our default branch is for development of our Bootstrap 6 release. Head to the [`v5-dev` branch](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/v5-dev) to view the readme, documentation, and source code for Bootstrap 5. ## Table of contents - [Quick start](#quick-start) - [Status](#status) - [What’s included](#whats-included) - [Bugs and feature requests](#bugs-and-feature-requests) - [Documentation](#documentation) - [Contributing](#contributing) - [Community](#community) - [Versioning](#versioning) - [Creators](#creators) - [Thanks](#thanks) - [Copyright and license](#copyright-and-license) ## Quick start Several quick start options are available: - [Download the latest release](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/archive/v6.0.0-alpha.1.zip) - Clone the repo: `git clone https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap.git` - Install with [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/): `npm install bootstrap@6.0.0-alpha.1` - Install with [yarn](https://yarnpkg.com/): `yarn add bootstrap@6.0.0-alpha.1` - Install with [Bun](https://bun.sh/): `bun add bootstrap@6.0.0-alpha.1` - Install with [Composer](https://getcomposer.org/): `composer require twbs/bootstrap:6.0.0-alpha.1` - Install with [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/): CSS: `Install-Package bootstrap` Sass: `Install-Package bootstrap.sass` Read the [Getting started page](https://getbootstrap.com/docs/6.0/getting-started/) for information on the framework contents, templates, examples, and more. ## Status [![Build Status](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/twbs/bootstrap/js.yml?branch=main&label=JS%20Tests&logo=github)](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/actions/workflows/js.yml?query=workflow%3AJS+branch%3Amain) Collective](https://img.shields.io/opencollective/sponsors/bootstrap?logo=opencollective&logoColor=fff)](#sponsors) ## What’s included Within the download you’ll find the following directories and files, logically grouping common assets and providing both compiled and minified variations.
Download contents ```text bootstrap/ ├── css/ │ ├── bootstrap-grid.css │ ├── bootstrap-grid.css.map │ ├── bootstrap-grid.min.css │ ├── bootstrap-grid.min.css.map │ ├── bootstrap-reboot.css │ ├── bootstrap-reboot.css.map │ ├── bootstrap-reboot.min.css │ ├── bootstrap-reboot.min.css.map │ ├── bootstrap-utilities.css │ ├── bootstrap-utilities.css.map │ ├── bootstrap-utilities.min.css │ ├── bootstrap-utilities.min.css.map │ ├── bootstrap.css │ ├── bootstrap.css.map │ ├── bootstrap.min.css │ └── bootstrap.min.css.map └── js/ ├── bootstrap.bundle.js ├── bootstrap.bundle.js.map ├── bootstrap.bundle.min.js ├── bootstrap.bundle.min.js.map ├── bootstrap.js ├── bootstrap.js.map ├── bootstrap.min.js └── bootstrap.min.js.map ```
We provide compiled CSS and JS (`bootstrap.*`), as well as compiled and minified CSS and JS (`bootstrap.min.*`). [Source maps](https://web.dev/articles/source-maps) (`bootstrap.*.map`) are available for use with certain browsers' developer tools. Bundled JS files (`bootstrap.bundle.js` and minified `bootstrap.bundle.min.js`) include [Floating UI](https://floating-ui.com/) and [Vanilla Calendar Pro](https://vanilla-calendar.pro/). All CSS files work for both LTR and RTL layouts thanks to logical properties—simply set `dir="rtl"` on your HTML element. ## Bugs and feature requests Have a bug or a feature request? Please first read the [issue guidelines](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md#using-the-issue-tracker) and search for existing and closed issues. If your problem or idea is not addressed yet, [please open a new issue](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/new/choose). ## Documentation Bootstrap’s documentation, included in this repo in the root directory, is built with [Astro](https://astro.build/) and publicly hosted on GitHub Pages at . The docs may also be run locally. Documentation search is powered by [Pagefind](https://pagefind.app/). ### Running documentation locally 1. Run `npm install` to install the Node.js dependencies, including Astro (the site builder). 2. Run `npm run test` (or a specific npm script) to rebuild distributed CSS and JavaScript files, as well as our docs assets. 3. From the root `/bootstrap` directory, run `npm run docs-serve` in the command line. 4. Open in your browser, and voilà. Learn more about using Astro by reading its [documentation](https://docs.astro.build/en/getting-started/). ### Documentation for previous releases You can find all our previous releases docs on . [Previous releases](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/releases) and their documentation are also available for download. ## Contributing Please read through our [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md). Included are directions for opening issues, coding standards, and notes on development. Moreover, if your pull request contains JavaScript patches or features, you must include [relevant unit tests](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/tree/main/js/tests). All HTML and CSS should conform to the [Code Guide](https://github.com/mdo/code-guide), maintained by [Mark Otto](https://github.com/mdo). Editor preferences are available in the [editor config](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/main/.editorconfig) for easy use in common text editors. Read more and download plugins at . ## Community Get updates on Bootstrap’s development and chat with the project maintainers and community members. - Follow [@getbootstrap on X](https://x.com/getbootstrap). - Read and subscribe to [The Official Bootstrap Blog](https://blog.getbootstrap.com/). - Ask questions and explore [our GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/orgs/twbs/discussions). - Discuss, ask questions, and more on [the community Discord](https://discord.gg/bZUvakRU3M) or [Bootstrap subreddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/bootstrap/). - Chat with fellow Bootstrappers in IRC. On the `irc.libera.chat` server, in the `#bootstrap` channel. - Implementation help may be found at Stack Overflow (tagged [`bootstrap-5`](https://stackoverflow.com/questions/tagged/bootstrap-5)). - Developers should use the keyword `bootstrap` on packages which modify or add to the functionality of Bootstrap when distributing through [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/browse/keyword/bootstrap) or similar delivery mechanisms for maximum discoverability. ## Versioning For transparency into our release cycle and in striving to maintain backward compatibility, Bootstrap is maintained under [the Semantic Versioning guidelines](https://semver.org/). Sometimes we screw up, but we adhere to those rules whenever possible. See [the Releases section of our GitHub project](https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/releases) for changelogs for each release version of Bootstrap. Release announcement posts on [the official Bootstrap blog](https://blog.getbootstrap.com/) contain summaries of the most noteworthy changes made in each release. ## Creators ### Mark Otto - - ### Jacob Thornton - - ## Thanks Thanks to [Netlify](https://www.netlify.com/) for providing us with Deploy Previews! ## Sponsors Support this project by becoming a sponsor.
